experiment: corpus scale: retrieve-then-dump vs retrieve cells

arms.dump: table index -> whole tables in rank order while they fit
arms.cell: corpus-wide S2 cell index -> cells while they fit
arms.cascade: top-1 table by table index, then its cells only
arms.cell2dump: tables ranked by their best cell, dumped whole
arms.row: corpus-wide row-chunk index -> whole data rows
arms.flat: corpus-wide cell index, LEAF labels only (ablation)
arms.capped: like `cell` but at most 3 cells per table
arms.group: same cells and same ranking as `cell`, but rendered grouped by table with the title stated ONCE -- the title is 29% of every S3 sentence and is what the gain comes from, so paying for it per table instead of per cell buys back budget at no information loss
